$comment: Advisories accepted for a limited time. Policy and how to add or remove an entry: docs/engineering/dependency-audit.md. Checked in CI by scripts/check-audit.mjs.

advisories.reason: ExcelJS reaches minimatch only through archive glob helpers during workbook ZIP output, using library-owned patterns rather than project-controlled patterns; the amplification input is not user controlled, and no compatible patched parent release exists yet.

Build and test tooling only: Vite, Vitest, tinyglobby and fdir use picomatch to match glob patterns written in this repository's own config files and scripts; no user input or project-file content becomes a glob, and picomatch is not in the shipped app. No patched release exists yet (4.0.7, the latest, is affected).
